title: Ember AI Launches Strategic Partner Program and New Oracle Health Integration
summary: Marketplace presence with athenahealth, ModMed, Veradigm and expanded EHR connectivity make proactive revenue integrity easier to deploy within providers' existing technology
body_markdown:
*Marketplace presence with athenahealth, ModMed, Veradigm and expanded EHR connectivity make proactive revenue integrity easier to deploy within providers' existing technology*


BURLINGAME, Calif., Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --[Ember AI](http://embercopilot.ai/) , the AI-powered revenue integrity platform that helps healthcare organizations collect every dollar they've earned, today announced the launch of its **Strategic Partner Program** , expanding the company's ecosystem of healthcare technology integrations to make proactive revenue integrity more accessible across the systems providers already use.


Through the program, specialty practices, hospitals and health systems can add AI-powered revenue integrity capabilities without replacing their existing infrastructure. Ember AI is available through the athenahealth, ModMed, Veradigm and NextGen Healthcare marketplaces, with additional connectivity across Epic, Nextech and other leading healthcare platforms.


As part of the expansion, Ember AI has added a native integration with **Oracle Health (Cerner)** , allowing organizations using Oracle Health to connect Ember AI directly to their EHR without a custom build. Once connected, Ember AI analyzes clinical and financial data across every encounter to identify coding issues, documentation gaps, reimbursement risks and other potential sources of revenue leakage before claims are submitted.


"Healthcare organizations have already invested heavily in the technology that powers their clinical and financial operations. Our goal is to make those systems work harder for them, not ask them to start over," said Charlene Wang, CEO and co-founder of Ember AI. "By building deeper connections across the healthcare technology ecosystem, we can make proactive revenue integrity easier to deploy and give providers a consistent approach to protecting revenue, regardless of the underlying technology."


The Oracle Health integration is already live across six major U.S. health systems. Using the integration, Ember AI customers have analyzed more than 1.2 million billable service lines, realized an average 41% reduction in preventable denials and a 35% reduction in recoverable denials headed for automatic write-off. Across production deployments, the technology has helped recover more than $2 million in revenue.


Beyond Oracle Health, Ember AI continues to expand its reach across specialty practices, hospitals and health systems, processing approximately 16 million healthcare transactions annually. The Strategic Partner Program builds on that momentum by expanding Ember AI's connectivity and making proactive revenue integrity easier to deploy within the systems providers already use.


To learn more about Ember AI and its partner ecosystem, visit[embercopilot.ai](http://embercopilot.ai/) .


## About Ember AI


Ember AI is the AI-powered revenue integrity platform that helps healthcare organizations collect every dollar they've earned. Built for the unique challenges of specialty healthcare, Ember AI combines AI with proven reimbursement expertise to level the playing field between providers and payers. By analyzing every encounter before the claim goes out the door, Ember AI proactively identifies coding issues, reimbursement risks, payer inconsistencies, and policy and rate opportunities — taking corrective actions that help organizations reduce risk and increase net revenue. Ember AI seamlessly integrates into existing workflows, allowing organizations to move quickly from implementation to measurable results. With cleaner claims, fewer denials, and no more appeal backlogs, Ember AI helps healthcare organizations create a more efficient, scalable revenue cycle, so clinics can focus on patient care.
